landing.title: Helping Dementia Patients Stay Connected with Their Memories
landing.subtitle: A cognitive assistance platform that creates personalized activities using family photos, familiar objects, and daily routines — making memory care meaningful and accessible.
landing.featuresDesc: Every feature is crafted with empathy and understanding for dementia patients and their caregivers.
landing.howItWorksDesc: Simple setup for caregivers, effortless use for patients.
landing.ctaDesc: Free plan available. Premium starts at just ₹299/month with full access to all cognitive games and analytics.
landing.footerText: Smart India Hackathon 2026 — Making Memory Care Accessible
landing.feature1Desc: AI-powered cognitive activities using your own family photos and familiar memories.
landing.feature2Desc: Store precious family photos and stories to create meaningful cognitive exercises.
landing.feature3Desc: Gentle reminders for medicine, meals, activities, and daily schedule management.
landing.feature4Desc: Works without internet. Essential cognitive activities available anytime, anywhere.
landing.feature5Desc: All data stays on the device. No cloud storage, no privacy concerns.
landing.feature6Desc: Simple setup by family members. Patient needs zero technical knowledge.
landing.step1Desc: Add patient details, upload family photos, and create a daily schedule.
landing.step2Desc: Patient engages with personalized cognitive games based on their own memories.
landing.step3Desc: Monitor cognitive improvement through dashboards and activity reports.

sakshi.aboutBrahmi:
**Brahmi AI** is your personal cognitive care assistant! 🧠

Named after the Brahmi herb (Bacopa monnieri), which is known in Ayurveda for boosting memory and brain health.

I'm here to help you stay connected with your memories, manage your daily routine, and keep your mind active! 💜
sakshi.aboutDementia:
**Dementia** is a condition that affects memory, thinking, and social abilities. It can make daily tasks challenging.

That's why Brahmi AI exists — to help you stay connected with your memories through personalized activities, family photos, and daily routines. 💜

You're doing great by using this app!
sakshi.aboutMemory:
Your **memory** is like a garden — the more you tend to it, the better it grows! 🌱

Playing memory games, looking at family photos, and following daily routines all help keep your mind sharp.

Would you like to play a memory game right now? 🧠
